crime: In the lounge, the victim mended a sewing basket and assured {WITCH_NAME} that her invitation was still coming. {WITCH_NAME} asked again, “You will invite me, won't you?” Earlier that day, before the promised invitation arrived, she had seen a group photograph on a phone: the gathering was already over, and it had gone on without her. Pressed, the victim admitted the assurance was only meant to appease her. At that admission, {WITCH_NAME} seized a sword and fatally stabbed her.

She expanded the basket's interior into a cavity large enough for the body, placed the victim inside, and pulled the lining over her. She then insisted to the prisoners that such a shallow basket could never hold a body. One prisoner reached in for the bottom and sank elbow-deep. She pulled out the lining and exposed the victim beneath it. The impossible depth shattered {WITCH_NAME}'s claim and exposed the concealment as the work of her Magic.
fields.epitaph: She would wait forever for the invitation that would never come.
execution: The execution stand binds her flat on her back across an enormous embroidery frame, arms and legs spread. A steel needle descends and stitches WELCOME across her chest. When it completes the final letter, her body lies motionless in the frame.

magic.name: Room to Spare
magic.text: She can make an enclosed space larger inside without changing its exterior.
